title: text-to-cad: your AI designs real parts
notes: Facts checked 2026-10-11: github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad (MIT; 19.0k stars, 1.9k forks; 2,369 stars that week) and texttocad.dev ('Give your agent CAD superpowers. 100% open source and free.'). A plugin and skills for agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Grok); install by sending your agent 'Install text-to-cad from https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad'. Generates 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF; a model is a plain Python (build123d) script with explicit dimensions, edited and re-run to regenerate its outputs; CAD viewer cards you can orbit in the chat (Claude Desktop and Code) or a CAD Viewer link. Skills: CAD from plain-language or image requests; step.parts (screws, bearings, motors, connectors); Engineering Drawing (dimensioned PDF); DXF; URDF, SRDF, SDF (robot description, simulation); SendCutSend; DfAM Check (wall thickness, overhangs, support volume, build orientation); DFM (sheet metal, CNC machining, injection molding); G-code (OrcaSlicer); Bambu Labs (Bambu Connect or Bambu Studio). Telemetry is on by default (usage stats and crash reports tagged with a random ID, never files, paths or prompts; off with uvx cadgen telemetry off). Windows 11 Smart App Control blocks the unsigned OCP kernel module; once turned off it can only be turned back on by reinstalling Windows; WSL is the alternative. Narration: Chatterbox (MIT) on the laptop's CPU.

lines.text: Then you just ask: a wall bracket for a shelf, 40 mm wide, with two screw holes.

lines.text: Your agent writes a short Python script, and that script is the part. You can spin it around right in the chat.

lines.text: Out comes a real CAD file: STEP for engineering software, or STL and 3MF for your 3D printer.
